method: Visual inspection of exported PNG at 6x nearest with an 8px coordinate grid. Mark physical front contact, or midpoint of two front support contacts. Coordinates are native pixels, origin top-left.
scope: Art depth reference for review only. Not collision geometry, socket, gameplay placement, or owner approval.

assets.basis: Midpoint of the visible bottom brass contact band. Not the canvas midpoint.
Lowest front vertex of the ivory octagonal plinth. Does not infer a collider from alpha.
Midpoint of two visible front base contacts, arithmetic ((28+96)/2,(64+90)/2). Image center is not used.
